title: Validation report generated from machine outputs: reproducible from the records, free of attestation wording, version and README numbers consistent

inputs: docs/validation/g3/*.json with the limits of docs/validation/cases/G3-*.json
fixture.judgement_rules: check_release_gates.judge_task imported as a function; stale evidence is a failure
fixture.tree_state: clean tree; the renderer refuses a dirty tree unless --allow-dirty, which marks the report PROVISIONAL

precision: not applicable: the report renders recorded numbers and runs no simulation
reference_method: the records themselves are the reference; the committed documents must equal a fresh render of them

observables.name: report_bytes_equal
observables.definition: a fresh render into a temporary path equals docs/VALIDATION_REPORT.md byte for byte

observables.name: scope_drift
observables.definition: the verification cells and the stage-status block of docs/RELEASE_SCOPE.md equal their regeneration from the gate file

observables.name: forbidden_words
observables.definition: occurrences of certificate, certified, certification or certify in the report (case-insensitive)

observables.name: consistency_mismatches
observables.definition: checks of the consistency section that report MISMATCH: package version across pyproject, COMPATIBILITY.md, CHANGELOG.md and the clean-install wheel name; every README row test of tests/test_readme_measurements.py; the README Meep block and MEEP_COMPARISON.md against the renderer; the RELEASE_SCOPE.md cells against the gate file

acceptance.reproducible: report_bytes_equal is true and scope_drift is false on the committed tree, and --check exits 0
acceptance.wording: the title reads 'internal validation report' and forbidden_words is 0
acceptance.consistency: consistency_mismatches is 0; the report lists every gate task once and every G3 task once with the FAILED findings visible
acceptance.source_of_limits: G9-07 in docs/COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md section 11: report from machine outputs, no third-party attestation wording, numbers, support tables, README and wheel version consistent

not_yet_covered: API documentation version strings (no generated API documentation exists at this version; COMPATIBILITY.md is the API document and is checked)
README rows without a machine record (Lumerical, flaport/fdtd, sweep, CPU-versus-GPU and ensemble rows are documented in MEASUREMENTS.md and have no record-backed test)

notes: Declared at 67cfd88 before the recorded run. The known-limitations list is a hand-maintained JSON whose entries cite their records; the report labels it as such.
